paper.title_en: Boundary-Geometry-Driven Black Hole Formation in Vacuum
paper.abstract_en: We identify a boundary-geometry-driven mechanism for the dynamical formation of marginally outer trapped surfaces (MOTSs) in vacuum general relativity. Mild three-dimensional anisotropies evolve inside a compact Cauchy domain whose effective isotropic thickness remains controlled, while the generalized boundary mean curvature can increase during either contracting or expanding boundary evolution. This drives the boundary across Yau's geometric threshold, forcing MOTS formation from initially untrapped data. We further interpret the characteristic shear construction of Ref.~\cite{MondalYau2026} as the null manifestation of the same anisotropic vacuum dynamics. The result provides a purely vacuum physical realization of MOTS formation through global geometric effects, without invoking a short-pulse concentration mechanism for gravitational radiation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出一种由边界几何驱动的真空中动态形成边缘外俘获面（MOTS）的新机制，属于广义相对论基础领域的重要理论进展。其方法严谨，结论具有新颖性，值得研究者关注。
decision.title_zh: 真空中的边界几何驱动的黑洞形成
decision.abstract_zh: 我们识别了一种由边界几何驱动的机制，用于在真空广义相对论中动态形成边缘外俘获面（MOTS）。在有效各向同性厚度保持受控的紧致柯西域内，温和的三维各向异性会演化，而广义边界平均曲率在边界收缩或膨胀演化期间都可以增加。这将边界驱动越过Yau的几何阈值，从而从初始未俘获数据强制形成MOTS。我们进一步将参考文献[cite]中的特征剪切构造解释为相同各向异性真空动力学的零类体现。该结果通过全局几何效应提供了MOTS形成的纯真空物理实现，而不涉及引力辐射的短脉冲集中机制。
